scenario: A marketplace operations analyst reviews a batch of buyer A-to-Z dispute claims. For each claim, the analyst uses the NLP toolkit to assess whether the buyer's dispute message appears to be human-written or automated/template-generated, applies the returns-and-reverse-logistics framework to compute a fraud score and disposition recommendation (refund, deny, or escalate), and then generates a consolidated dispute disposition report summarizing the outcomes.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyzes each buyer dispute message and outputs authenticity metrics (perplexity, burstiness, isAI flag) → returns-reverse-logistics uses those metrics alongside claim metadata (return value, account age, product category) to compute a fraud score and disposition → reporting compiles all dispositions into a structured dispute report.
